AntiPattern.WhyBad: Forbidden by `AX_BINARY_SEVERITY`. A warning is a finding nobody owns: CI green, agent moves on, warning rots. `no-floating-promises` as warning is especially dangerous — a class of bugs (lost errors, broken ordering) discovered and ignored on every CI run. No path back from `'warn'` to a real fix the agent will take on its own.
AntiPattern.Good: Each rule resolved to `'error'` (with motivation comment if non-autofix) or `'off'` (with one-line reason).
